rules.name: At All Costs
rules.description:
Until the start of your next Command phase:
  -> At the start of your Command phase:
    -> Select one:
      - Eliminate At All Costs: at the start of your Command phase: select one enemy unit (your Eliminate At All Costs target); until the start of your next Command phase, each time a friendly unit attacks it, the unit gets +1 to Hit rolls.
      - Acquire At All Costs: while the unit is within range of an objective marker, add 1 to the unit's Leadership characteristic; add 1 to the unit's Objective Control characteristic; the unit has a 5+ invulnerable save.

rules.name: Root out Heresy
rules.description:
Ranged weapons equipped by all friendly models with the ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITOR, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS keyword gain [IGNORES COVER].
Against CHAOS targets, if the target unit contains 5+ models, the weapons of all friendly models with the ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITOR, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS keyword gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

rules.name: Extremis Sanction
rules.description:
The number of uses of all friendly OFFICIO ASSASSINORUM units' Overkill ability is 2.
The number of uses of all friendly OFFICIO ASSASSINORUM units' Soulless Horror ability is 2.
The number of uses of all friendly OFFICIO ASSASSINORUM units' Shieldbreaker ability is 2.

rules.name: Deathwatch Mission Tactics
rules.description:

  -> At the start of your Command phase:
    -> Select one (each may be chosen once per battle):
      - Furor Tactics: the unit's weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
      - Malleus Tactics: the unit's weapons gain [LETHAL HITS].
      - Purgatus Tactics: the unit's weapons gain [PRECISION].

rules.name: Destroy the Daemonic
rules.description:
You can re-roll a Hit roll of 1 for attacks made by all friendly models with the INQUISITOR, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO MALLEUS keyword.
Against DAEMON targets, you can re-roll a Wound roll of 1 for attacks made by all friendly models with the INQUISITOR, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO MALLEUS keyword.
